decisions.reason: The organic sliced platter is only mentioned on the website, which signals lower internal priority, but one year is too little evidence to judge it against aspiration levels, and the firm has enough slack to keep it while results remain uncertain.
Its own dedicated page shows ongoing commitment to the growing organic poultry snacking segment, and with no clear shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The premium sharing snack has prominent website presence and fits the firm's established salami competence, so management will likely keep it while sales data accumulate.
